prompt: Write the body (about 180 words) of a demand letter from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer before a lawsuit. Accident: sideswipe while changing lanes. Injury: neck strain. Use the exact placeholders [CLIENT_NAME], [LOSS_DATE] and [DEMAND_AMOUNT]. No other names or dates. (Internal reference C-1113; do not mention it.)
text:
Our firm represents [CLIENT_NAME] in connection with the motor vehicle collision that occurred on [LOSS_DATE]. Our client was lawfully traveling in the proper lane when your insured changed lanes without signaling or checking that the adjacent lane was clear, striking the driver's side of our client's vehicle and forcing it toward the shoulder. Liability for this collision rests squarely with your insured, whose failure to yield the right of way violated the applicable traffic code and constitutes negligence.

As a direct result of the impact, our client suffered a cervical strain with significant neck pain, stiffness, and reduced range of motion. Our client was evaluated at the emergency department on the day of the accident and has since attended ongoing physical therapy and chiropractic care. Treating providers have documented restricted movement and recommended continued treatment. Our client has also missed time from work and has been unable to perform routine household and recreational activities without pain.

Accordingly, we demand payment of [DEMAND_AMOUNT] to resolve all claims arising from this collision. This figure reflects medical expenses to date, lost wages, the cost of anticipated future care, and compensation for pain and suffering. Please provide your response in writing within thirty days of the date of this letter. If we do not receive a satisfactory resolution by that date, we are prepared to file suit without further notice.
